title: The support-kernel adjoint for an arbitrary pro-etale ring sheaf
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion, and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ its quasi-compact open complement [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $B$ be any sheaf of commutative rings on the small pro-etale site of $X$, using sites small in the sheaf universe [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over $B$, $i^{-1}B$, $j^{-1}B$, with inverse image, direct image and extension by zero as in [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]. For a $B$-module sheaf $N$ set $H_N=\ker(N\to j_*j^*N)$ and $i^!_0N=i^*H_N$, where $i^*=i^{-1}$ and $j^*=j^{-1}$ with these pulled-back coefficient rings. There is a natural identification $H_N\cong i_*i^!_0N$ carrying its inclusion into $N$ to the counit, and natural module-linear bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_X(i_*P,N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_Z(P,i^!_0N)$.

On the unbounded derived categories of these module categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], $Ri^!_0K=i^!_0I_K$, for a K-injective resolution $K\to I_K$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex], is right adjoint to the exact $i_*$. The derived counit is induced by the sheaf counit. The other derived adjunctions are $j_!\dashv j^*$, $i^*\dashv i_*$ and $j^*\dashv Rj_*$. Their ordinary termwise closed counit and derived open counit give $i^*i_*\cong1$ and $j^*Rj_*\cong1$, and $j^*i_*=0$. These assertions make no boundedness or constructibility assumption and do not use a supported localization triangle.

proof.text: Take the closed adjunction, the open-slice equivalence, extension-by-zero adjunction, exact closed direct image and open-closed exact sequence from the ringed open-closed theorem. Its existing ringedInverseImageAdjunction construction supplies the open inverse/direct-image adjunction. The immersion theorem supplies additive exact closed and open inverse images. Transport extension by zero along the open-slice equivalence to obtain j_! left adjoint to j^*.

source.place: Tags 09AA, 09BM, 09AH and 09BN; the existing small-model module adjunction

proof.text: The extension-by-zero unit is invertible, so extension by zero is fully faithful, also after composing with the open-slice equivalence. For the adjoint triple j_! left adjoint to j^* left adjoint to j_*, Mathlib Adjunction.Triple.isIso_unit_iff_isIso_counit gives the invertible open counit. The open triangle identity then makes j^* of the open adjunction unit invertible. This avoids a second sectionwise open-comparison calculation.

Let H be the functor-category kernel of the open unit, with inclusion k. Evaluation preserves this kernel, and exact j^* carries it to the kernel of an isomorphism, hence j^*H_N is zero. The open-closed exact sequence on H_N has zero left term; its right arrow, the closed unit, is both epic and monic and hence invertible. Whiskering that unit with H gives exactly the specified natural comparison H isomorphic to i_* i^* H.

source.place: Tag 09AH applied to the support kernel

proof.text: The closed counit is invertible, so i_* is fully faithful. Since j^*i_*P is zero, naturality of the open unit shows that every map i_*P to N factors through k_N. The factor is unique because k_N is monic. Full faithfulness transports this factor, followed by the supported closed unit, to a map P to i^*H_N. Conversely map under i_*, then compose with the inverse supported unit and k_N. These operations give a natural Hom equivalence. Construct the adjunction from it. The image of the identity is the inverse supported unit followed by k_N, so the specified counit equation holds. Additivity of i^*H follows from this right-adjoint description.

Apply Adjunction.localization to the termwise complex adjunctions for the two exact pairs (i^*,i_*) and (j_!,j^*), using mapDerivedCategoryFactors as their comparison squares. This directly gives the exact derived adjunctions without identifying a separate total right derived functor. The localization counit formula is exactly the stated closed derived counit on QI.

Use the existing source-library Adjunction.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction for the additive pairs (i_*,i^!_0) and (j^*,j_*), whose left adjoints are exact. It applies the termwise homotopy adjunction to the K-injective right derivability structure and exact left-derived comparison. The pro-etale operations interface supplies the chosen derived categories and K-injective resolutions. This constructs precisely the rightDerivedFunctor adjunctions in the statement.

source.place: Tags 070I, 070K and 08BJ; source-library unbounded derived adjunction

proof.text: On a K-injective I, the right-derived unit is invertible. Solve derived counit factorization for the counit, then use mapHomotopyCategory_counit_app_quotient and mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app. Naturality of quotientCompQhIso converts the result to complexes, and the definition of rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso gives exactly the required K-injective counit formula.

source.place: Tags 070I and 070K; counit factorization on K-injectives

proof.text: For a quasi-isomorphism r:K to I with I K-injective, apply counit naturality to Q(r). Insert the K-injective formula of the preceding step and cancel Q(r), which is invertible. Functoriality combines the right-derived image of Q(r) with the K-injective comparison into exactly ringedClosedKernelResolutionIso. This proves the prescribed resolution formula for every such r.

source.place: Tags 070I and 070K; naturality under the localized resolution

proof.text: The ordinary closed and open counits are isomorphisms in every degree. The exact-localization formula therefore proves invertibility of the closed derived counit, and the K-injective formula proves invertibility of the open derived counit on every derived object. Finally exact direct image commutes with homology. Since j^* kills i_* of every module, it kills all homology objects of the derived direct image; the exact-functor zero criterion proves j^*i_*=0 in the derived categories. No supported triangle or boundedness assumption is used.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N9-408d0d4d1 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, which has no new nodes and an unchanged statement, and all 9 of its proof steps in full, along with the full statements of every cited node. Stacks proetale.tex checks out at each cited place: 09AA lemma-closed-immersion, 09BM (exactness of i_* needs a retrocompact complement, which matches the quasi-compact j in the statement), 09BN (j^{-1}j_* is the identity) and 09AH (the short exact sequence when j is quasi-compact). The arguments are correct. Step 1 gets i^*⊣i_* and j^*⊣j_* from the ringed-topoi adjunction with c=id, identifying the tensor pullback by explicit inverse maps. Step 2 proves the open counit is invertible by evaluating on the slice, which is 09BN written out. Step 3: j^*H_N=0, so 09AH on H_N makes the supported unit an isomorphism. Step 4: the Hom bijection and its inverse are verified, and the counit is k_N h_N^{-1}. Step 6 applies right-adjoint-preserves-K-injectives with the exact left adjoint i_*, which is the correct direction. Steps 7 and 8 build the unbounded derived adjunctions through K-injective Hom bijections and the termwise homotopy adjunction. Step 9 shows the open derived counit is invertible degreewise on a K-injective, with no claim that higher direct images vanish. proof_deps equals the union of the steps' uses. Small cases tested: Z empty, U empty (also with nonreduced Z), B=0 and nonconstant B. No Noetherian, bounded or constructible hypothesis is used, and no SGA source is cited. I accept all declared tool_uses: ringed open-closed, ringed-topoi adjunction, immersion exactness, open comparison, and the K-injective and derived-functor lemmas. They are generic, and the unit's own nodes are stated only for finite constant coefficients, so none of them gives these facts for an arbitrary ring sheaf. The item gives the parent prop-sf-localization-all-stages, at its Step 2, exactly what it uses. Duplicate check: det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction, in the same unit, gives the adjunction only for coefficients pulled back from a condensed ring. The finite-ring Noetherian nodes lem-exc-proetale-closed-support and lem-exc-proetale-derived-adjunction-triangle are narrower. The item generalizes these and restates none of them. Only cosmetic point: Step 1 could also cite def-weil-proetale-inverse-image for the morphism of topoi, but that node is already in proof_deps. No changes made.
